headerDisplay: Send notifications through the [Notify! API](https://getnotifyapp.com/apidocs/) using HomeKit switches. Each webhook appears as a switch that turns itself off a second after being activated. Running as a child bridge is recommended for better stability.
footerDisplay: Need somewhere to host icons? Visit [https://icons.getnotifyapp.com/](https://icons.getnotifyapp.com/)

name.title: Platform Name
name.description: The name that will appear in your Homebridge log.

name.title: Webhook Name
name.description: The name of the switch as it will appear in HomeKit. Must be unique.

token.title: Token
token.description: Your Notify API token, from the Notify! app.

id.title: ID
id.description: Device ID, web device ID, or Group ID. Group IDs are 'GRP' plus 5 characters; web device IDs are 'WB' plus 14 characters. The API detects the type automatically.

title.title: Notification Title
title.description: Optional title shown above the message.

groupType.title: Thread ID
groupType.description: Optional threading identifier. Notifications sharing a value collapse into one thread on the device (for example 'security' or 'doorbell'). This does not affect addressing: a group send goes to every member regardless.

iconURL.title: Icon URL
iconURL.description: Optional HTTPS URL for the small circular sender icon. Host icons at https://icons.getnotifyapp.com/ if you need somewhere to put them.

imageUrl.title: Hero Image URL
imageUrl.description: Optional HTTPS URL for a larger image shown when the notification is expanded. JPEG, PNG or GIF, up to 10 MB.

timeSensitive.title: Time Sensitive
timeSensitive.description: Allow this notification to break through Focus and Do Not Disturb. Reserve it for genuine alerts such as leaks, smoke or security events.
